en.headline: Swire Pacific raises about HK$3.57 billion from 4.15 percent Cathay stake sale
en.dek: The conglomerate placed shares at HK$14.23 each, an 8.5 percent discount to Monday's close, and will retain around 35 percent as the largest shareholder.
body: Swire Pacific said it has raised approximately HK$3.57 billion through a placing of 252.7 million shares in Cathay Pacific Airways, representing about 4.15 percent of the airline's issued capital.

The shares were sold at HK$14.23 each, an 8.5 percent discount to Cathay Pacific's closing price of HK$15.55 on Monday, when the stock reached its highest level in more than 11 years. Swire expects to record a gain of about HK$870 million from the transaction.

Upon completion, Swire Pacific's interest in Cathay Pacific will fall to around 35 percent. The company will remain the largest shareholder. J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and HSBC acted as placing agents. The proceeds are intended for general working capital.

zh.headline: 太古出售國泰航空4.15%股份 籌得約35.7億元
zh.dek: 太古以每股14.23元配售股份，較周一收市價折讓約8.5%，配售後仍持有約35%股權，繼續為最大股東。
body: 太古表示，透過配售約2.527億股國泰航空股份，佔已發行股本約4.15%，籌得約35.7億元。
股份以每股14.23元出售，較國泰航空周一收市價15.55元折讓約8.5%。當日國泰股價升至逾11年高位。太古預計交易將帶來約8.7億元收益。
配售完成後，太古在國泰的持股將降至約35%，並繼續為最大股東。配售代理為摩根大通、摩根士丹利及滙豐。所得款項將用作一般營運資金。
